findings.title: PartitionService tests are non-deterministic due to unseeded Random
findings.rule_violated: Testing: tests must be deterministic and reproducible; unseeded Random produces different results per run
findings.remediation: Inject Random or an IRandomProvider into PartitionService. Tests should use new Random(42) for deterministic shuffling.

findings.title: ContestManager ExportDataAsync/ImportDataAsync are structurally untestable due to concrete ContestDbContext dependency
findings.rule_violated: SOLID:DIP — depending on concrete implementation prevents unit testing of I/O-bound methods
findings.remediation: Extract IDatabaseExportImport interface with ExportAsync/ImportAsync, implement in ContestDbContext, inject into ContestManager.

findings.title: LocalStorage backup/restore pipeline has zero test coverage across all layers
findings.rule_violated: Testing: critical data persistence path (only persistence in Blazor WASM) has no coverage
findings.remediation: Extract backup/restore to dedicated IBackupService. Add integration test for round-trip: write data, backup, wipe, restore, verify.

findings.title: BradleyTerryResolutionService convergence and early-exit paths completely untested
findings.rule_violated: Testing: algorithmic correctness — convergence path with the most complex logic (MLE + rank stability) is unexercised
findings.remediation: Add test with 10+ entries and partial rankings requiring 50+ iterations. Add tests for empty input, single entry, and MaxIterations exhaustion.

findings.title: CalculateScoresFromStrengths untested across all three scoring strategies
findings.rule_violated: Testing: IScoringStrategy interface has two methods; only CalculateScores is tested; CalculateScoresFromStrengths exercises different code paths
findings.remediation: Add tests for each strategy's CalculateScoresFromStrengths with varied strengths, identical strengths (range < 1e-9), and single entry.

findings.title: Repository UpdateAsync and GetAllAsync methods have zero test coverage
findings.rule_violated: Testing: CRUD operations not covered — UpdateAsync/GetAllAsync are not tested in any repository
findings.remediation: Add tests for all UpdateAsync and GetAllAsync methods across all three repositories. Include edge: update non-existent ID, empty table, update with zero scores.

findings.title: ValidatePartitionedGraph tests fail to assert error message content
findings.rule_violated: Testing: assertions must verify the specific failure reason, not just that failure occurred
findings.remediation: Add Assert.Equal(...) for result.ErrorMessage in both disconnected and cycle test cases to validate correct error discrimination.

findings.title: LessThan operator never tested in IsTotalOrder or IsValidOrder
findings.rule_violated: Testing: enum value coverage — Operator.LessThan is used in production (keyboard handler) but not in any validation test
findings.remediation: Add one test each for IsTotalOrder and IsValidOrder with a LessThan relation to verify directional inversion.

findings.title: Non-existent ID and empty-table repository edge cases untested
findings.rule_violated: Testing: edge case and error path coverage for data access layer
findings.remediation: Add tests: GetByIdAsync with non-existent ID returns null, AddAsync with duplicate ID, DeleteAsync with non-existent ID, GetAllAsync on empty table.

findings.title: Tests pass null! for ContestDbContext masking null safety and blocking Export/Import testing
findings.rule_violated: Testing: null! suppression in tests — future code that accesses _context will NullReference in production but not in tests
findings.remediation: Abstract ContestDbContext behind an interface for I/O methods (see TE-002) or add a constructor null check and use a Moq mock.

findings.title: E2E tests are shallow smoke tests with no functional workflow validation
findings.rule_violated: Testing: E2E tests should validate critical user workflows, not just page render
findings.remediation: Add E2E test for full judging workflow: create category, add entries, record comparisons, calculate results, verify leaderboard. Add backup/restore test.

findings.title: TrimmingSafetyTests uses fragile string-contains assertions for JSON validation
findings.rule_violated: Testing: string-based assertions on serialized output are fragile and nondeterministic
findings.remediation: Remove the string-contains assertions. The deserialized object check on lines 38-39 already validates correct round-trip.

findings.title: PartitionService constructor validation (k <= 0, invalid overlap) untested
findings.rule_violated: Testing: constructor guard clauses should be verified with theory/parameterized tests
findings.remediation: Add Theory with InlineData for: k=0, k=-1, overlap=-0.1, overlap=1.1 — all should throw ArgumentException.

findings.title: Duplicate validation code in three methods makes test coverage misleading
findings.rule_violated: DRY: duplicated validation logic means tests for one method don't prove correctness of duplicate code in another
findings.remediation: Extract BuildUnionFindAndAdjacency and TryTopologicalSort as private methods. Re-audit test coverage after refactor.

findings.title: ScoringStrategy empty-tiers and single-entry edge cases untested
findings.evidence_snippet:
// All three scoring files: early return for empty tiers untested
if (k == 0) return assignedScores;           // LinearSpacing, DefinedInterval
if (totalEntries == 0) return assignedScores; // Percentile
if (totalEntries == 1 || sortedTiers.Count == 1) { ... }  // Percentile single entry path
findings.rule_violated: Testing: edge case and boundary condition coverage for algorithmic methods
findings.remediation: Add tests: empty tiers for each strategy, single entry/single tier for PercentileScoring.

findings.title: Entry.SetScore boundary values (0 and maxScore) never tested
findings.rule_violated: Testing: boundary value analysis — valid edge values at the boundary should be tested
findings.remediation: Add Theory with InlineData for SetScore(category, 0) and SetScore(category, category.MaxScore) to validate boundary acceptance.
